newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent all square heading into London trading.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent all square heading into London trading.

text.p: Brent crude futures trading in Asia were steady in late afternoon dealings on Friday heading into London dealings.
Brokers said the market was largely marking time ahead of London and in the absence of a NYMEX market trading on the after hours ACCESS system.
January Brent on SIMEX was last traded at $22.60 per barrel after a slight 15 lots, level with overnight London.
Brokers said there was little to excite the market with both the OPEC roll over and news Iraqi oil will flow via the Turkish pipeline by December 15 coming as no major surprise.
A broker said he expected January Brent to maintain a trading range of $22.50 to $23.00.
New York markets were closed for Thanksgiving Holiday and the IPE in London was scheduled to shut at the earlier than normal 1730 GMT later on Friday.
Markets resume normal operations on Monday.
